name: chmod
description: Set POSIX permission bits (mode & 07777). Returns { applied }: true where the bits were set; false on Windows, where POSIX modes do not exist and the call is a successful no-op on an existing path. A missing path answers `ENOENT: …`. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: File or directory; relative paths resolve against the host cwd.
